comparison.objective: Insert and lock a hose fitting in a sprung quick-connect coupler.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually retract a collar, align and insert a nipple, then release the collar into its groove.
comparison.success_condition: The fitting must be seated, pawl-engaged, collar-forward, released, still, and able to resist a 10 N pull.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment and sliding, but this record tests collar actuation and latch engagement. It does not test a moving carriage bridging two supports or preservation of freely moving bearing balls.
